metadata.label: Population by district, Landscape or Part of the country by sex. Year 2025
note:
From the reference year 2025 onwards, a small controlled random uncertainty is introduced in all reported data. The uncertainty has been added to protect individuals so that no one risks being exposed in the statistics. As a result, the reported totals are not always equal to the sum of their reported components.  
 
  
If reported statistical values are added together to create a new total, the uncertainty is also added. There is therefore a risk that the new total contains greater uncertainty than that which – under the method – would have been added to a single value. 
 
  
The method used for disclosure control is called Cell Key Method (CKM). You can read more about the method here: [Protection methods for disclosure control](https://www.scb.se/en/documentation/statististical-methods/protection-methods-for-disclosure-control/) and here: [Development of disclosure protection](https://www.scb.se/en/documentation/statistical-areas-under-change/development-of-disclosure-protection/).

The district is a geographical division of Sweden consisting of 2523 areas that were introduced in the civil registry database January 1, 2016. Districts are based on an adjusted version of the parish areas on 31 December 1999. The districts is stable in the sense that the areas will not change in the future. District boundaries do not follow either the property or municipal borders. Districts situated in more than one municipality (kommun), is registered at one municipality based on population size.

A districts placing in Sweden can be inferred from the first three positions in the district code. The last three positions is a serial number unique within each Landscape.
In some cases district border cutting across a Landscape border. The landscape code is then the Landscape were most of the districts area is.
Part of the country  (Region Greater): 1-3 (Götaland, Svealand, Norrland)
Landscape: 01-25 (Landscape goes from southwest to northeast)
District: 001-453 (Districts within a Landscape goes from southwest to northeast). The maximum value depends on how many districts there are within the Landscape.

A number of persons lack information on district but have information on municipality.
It is mainly people who are registered on the fictional properties  'On municipality registered' or 'without known residence'.
If all districts in a municipality belong to the same landscape it is assumed that those who lack information on the district also belongs to the Landscape.
If all the districts of the municipality are in the same Part of the country (region greater) it is assumed that all people in the municipality belongs to the same Part of the country.

Region.label: region
note: Population data for the landscapes are calculated using the the district division.
